Description: The lane detection algorithm shall complete analysis within 100ms per camera frame at 30fps. ASIL B - Reference: ADAS-SYS-001
The brake actuator controller shall send PWM command within 150ms of object detection trigger. ASIL D - Reference: ADAS-SYS-002
The CNN classifier shall achieve >99.5% precision on EuroNCAP vulnerable road user dataset. ASIL C - Reference: ADAS-SYS-003
The Kalman filter task shall execute at 50Hz minimum integrating LIDAR camera and radar streams. ASIL B - Reference: ADAS-SYS-004
The watchdog handler shall transition to fail-safe mode within 50ms of detected fault. ASIL D - Reference: ADAS-SYS-005
The diagnostic logger shall write all critical events to non-volatile memory with RTC timestamp
The OTA update module shall verify firmware CRC-32 before applying flash
The HMI module shall display visual and audible alerts within 200ms of event trigger
